A comparative split-panel illustration. On the left, Jesus sitting on a grassy hillside (Mount) teaching a large crowd, with a banner reading "Matthew 5: Nine Spiritual Beatitudes". On the right, Jesus standing on a flat, level field (Plain) teaching people, with a banner reading "Luke 6: Four Physical Beatitudes & Four Woes".

An illustration showing a scale or a fork in a path. On one side, earthly treasures: a chest overflowing with gold coins, but with moths flying around it, rust creeping over the chest, and a thief sneaking in the background. On the other side, a glowing chest in the clouds, representing heavenly treasures, untouched and shining with divine light.
